metadata.name: ugt
metadata.description: Urban Game Theory - parcel anchors, design and plan records, agreements (Solana)

instructions.name: anchor_parcels
docs: Create the anchors of `parcel_ids` (each with its fixed metadata URI) that do not exist yet,
one remaining account per id: the PDA ["parcel", parcel_id], writable. Anyone pays; nobody owns.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the rent of every anchor this call creates.

instructions.name: attest
docs: Record the lens's satisfied decision from its AgreementDecision-v1 attestation.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: issuer and payload are checked in the handler.

accounts.name: credential
docs: checked in the handler.

instructions.name: cancel
docs: The authority withdraws an agreement whose decision is not recorded; the escrow returns to it.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Signs the cancellation and receives the refund.

instructions.name: create
docs: Commit an agreement to the chain (agreement.rs: `create`).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The sponsor: part of the address, pays the rent, the only key that may fund or cancel, and
the one every refund returns to.

instructions.name: create_record
docs: Record `cid` as a design (kind 1) or plan (kind 2) published by the signer, and mint its
Metaplex Core asset (`name`, `uri`) to the signer. Refused when the record exists.

accounts.name: asset
docs: the CPI (this program signs for the PDA), so it must not exist yet.

accounts.name: minter
docs: The publisher: pays the rent of the record and the asset, receives the asset.

instructions.name: execute
docs: Pay the escrow of a satisfied, funded agreement to its payout.

instructions.name: expire
docs: Anyone expires an agreement past its deadline; the escrow returns to the authority.

instructions.name: fund
docs: The authority moves `lamports` into the escrow.

accounts.name: authority
docs: Pays the lamports in.

errors.name: NotActive
errors.msg: The agreement is not Active

errors.name: NotAttested
errors.msg: No decision has been attested for this agreement

errors.name: DeadlinePassed
errors.msg: The agreement's deadline has passed

errors.name: DeadlineNotPassed
errors.msg: The agreement's deadline has not passed, or it has none

errors.name: Underfunded
errors.msg: The escrow holds less than the agreement's required funding

errors.name: WrongLens
errors.msg: The attestation was not issued by the agreement's lens

errors.name: InvalidAttestation
errors.msg: The account is not a valid SAS attestation or credential, or the credential's authority did not sign it

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Only the agreement's authority may do this

errors.name: CidTooLong
errors.msg: The CID is longer than 64 bytes

errors.name: InvalidCid

errors.name: InvalidPayout

errors.name: ZeroAmount

errors.name: WrongAuthority

errors.name: WrongPayout

errors.name: AlreadyAttested

errors.name: DecisionSatisfied

errors.name: AttestationExpired

errors.name: WrongSchema

errors.name: InvalidAttestationPayload

errors.name: WrongAgreement
errors.msg: The attestation is about a different agreement

errors.name: InvalidDecision
errors.msg: The attested decision must be satisfied

errors.name: AttestationFromFuture
errors.msg: The attestation's source time is in the future

errors.name: ArithmeticOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: InsufficientEscrowBalance
errors.msg: Insufficient escrow balance

errors.name: WrongSponsor
errors.msg: The attestation names a different sponsor than the agreement's authority

errors.name: InvalidParcelId

errors.name: InvalidMetadataUri
errors.msg: A metadata URI must be 1-200 bytes

errors.name: InvalidAnchorBatch
errors.msg: anchor_parcels takes 1-16 parcel ids, as many metadata URIs, and one writable remaining account per id

errors.name: WrongParcelAccount
errors.msg: A remaining account is not the writable anchor PDA of its parcel id

errors.name: InvalidKind
errors.msg: A record kind is 1 (design) or 2 (plan)

errors.name: InvalidName
errors.msg: An asset name must be 1-100 bytes

errors.name: InvalidUri

errors.name: AssetExists

errors.name: WrongProgram
errors.msg: The account is not the Metaplex Core program

types.name: Agreement
docs: One agreement: PDA ["agreement", authority, sha256(cid)]. Every fixed-size field comes before
`cid`, so their offsets are the same in every account (README, "Agreement account") and memcmp
filters on authority, lens, status or plan_cid_hash work.

fields.name: authority
docs: The sponsor (part of the address): pays the rent, is the only key that may fund or cancel,
receives refunds.

fields.name: lens
docs: The lens member key whose AgreementDecision attestation settles the agreement.

fields.name: payout
docs: Receives the whole escrow at execution.

fields.name: deadline
docs: Unix seconds; NO_DEADLINE (0) for none.

fields.name: required_lamports
docs: Escrow execution needs (0: none).

fields.name: escrow_lamports
docs: Lamports brought in by `fund` and not yet paid out or refunded.

fields.name: open_ground
docs: The agreement's land includes open ground (recorded for readers; no effect on execution).

fields.name: decision_attested_at
docs: Chain time the decision was recorded (0 while Pending).

fields.name: decision_observed_at
docs: The attestation's sourceObservedAt (0 while Pending).

fields.name: decision_attestation
docs: The AgreementDecision attestation that was recorded (default key while Pending).

fields.name: decision_hash
docs: sha256 of that attestation's whole account bytes.

fields.name: executed_at
docs: Chain time of execution (0 unless Executed).

fields.name: plan_cid_hash
docs: sha256 of the plan CID the agreement names (agreement/v1 `planCid`): the memcmp that lists a
plan's agreements.

fields.name: input_count
docs: The agreement's number of input parcels (agreement/v1 `inputs.parcels`), for readers.

fields.name: cid
docs: The agreement's CIDv1 (`bafkrei…`), the IPFS object this account commits to.

fields.name: attestation_hash
docs: sha256 of the attestation's whole account bytes.

fields.name: refunded_lamports
docs: Returned to the authority.

fields.name: lamports
docs: The escrow released to `payout`.

fields.name: refunded_lamports
docs: Returned to the authority.

fields.name: escrow_lamports
docs: The escrow after this fund.

types.name: AgreementStatus
docs: Same codes as the retired proposal_nft's ProposalStatus.

types.name: Decision
docs: The lens's recorded decision; Pending until `attest`. The lens never refuses, so there is no
other value: an agreement whose rule is not satisfied by its deadline expires.

fields.name: kind
docs: KIND_DESIGN (1) or KIND_PLAN (2); byte 8 of the account.

fields.name: minter
docs: The publisher: signed the create, paid the rent, owns the asset.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Chain time of the create.

fields.name: asset
docs: The Metaplex Core asset minted for this record.

fields.name: cid
docs: The CIDv1 (`bafkrei…`) of the design/v1 or plan/v1 object this record commits to.
